Definition: Joram, the name of three Israelites and one Syrian
BiblicalUsage: Joram is named 16 times in the Bible, and the passages here are 2 Samuel 8:10; 2 Kings 8:16; 1 Chronicles 3:11. In 2 Samuel 8:10 we read, "Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and 1 Chronicles 3:11 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Joram comes to us in a list, yet I hold that a list was God's way of keeping a family. The record keeps him, and I am glad it does.
RelatedPeople: Joram, Son of Toi; Joram, Son of Jehoshaphat
